identificationModule.briefTitle: PM8002 in Combination With Paclitaxel Compared With Chemotherapy as Second-line Treatment in Small Cell Lung Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Multicenter, Open-lable, Randomized Phase III Study of PM8002 in Combination With Paclitaxel Compared With Chemotherapy as Second-line Treatment in Small Cell Lung Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: PM8002 is a bispecific antibody targeting PD-L1 and VEGF. This study will evaluate the efficacy and safety of PM8002 in combination with Paclitaxel as second-line treatment for SCLC
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: This multicenter, randomized, open-label phase III study will evaluate the efficacy and safety of PM8002 in combination with Paclitaxel versus Investigator's Choice (Topotecan or Paclitaxel) as second-line treatment for subjects with SCLC.

armGroups.label: PM8002+Paclitaxel
armGroups.description: Subjects will be administered with PM8002 in combination with Paclitaxel via intravenously (IV) infusion.

armGroups.label: Chemotherapy
armGroups.description: Subjects will be administered with Investigator's Choice(Topotecan or Paclitaxel) via intravenously (IV) infusion Q3W.

interventions.name: PM8002
interventions.description: Following a predefined dose and date.

interventions.name: Paclitaxel
interventions.description: 175mg/m2 via IV infusion on Day 1 Q3W

interventions.name: Topotecan
interventions.description: 1.25mg/m2/day via IV infusion on Days 1-5 Q3W

primaryOutcomes.description: Overall survival is defined as the time from randomization to death due to any cause. Participants without documented death at the time of the analysis are censored at the date of the last follow-up.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to approximately 32 months from first patient in

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Progression-Free Survival (PFS) assessed by evaluated by investigator
secondaryOutcomes.description: PFS is defined as the time from randomization to the first documented PD per RECIST 1.1 based on assessments by investigator or death due to any cause, whichever occurs first. Per RECIST 1.1, PD is defined as ≥20% increase in the sum of diameters of target lesions. In addition to the relative increase of 20%, the sum must also have demonstrated an absolute increase of ≥5 mm. The appearance of one or more new lesions is also considered PD.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to approximately 32 months from first patient in

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Objective response rate (ORR) evaluated by investigator
secondaryOutcomes.description: ORR is defined as the percentage of participants in the analysis population who have a complete response (CR: disappearance of all lesions) or partial response (PR: at least a 30% decrease in the sum of diameters of target lesions). The percentage of participants who experienced a CR or PR as assessed by investigators based on RECIST 1.1 is presented.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to approximately 32 months from first patient in

secondaryOutcomes.description: DCR is defined as the sum rate of CR, PR and Stable Disease (SD), as determined by investigators based on RECIST v1.1
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to approximately 32 months from first patient in

secondaryOutcomes.description: Time to response(TTR) is defined as the time from randomization to the first documented PR or CR assssed by investigator based on RECIST v1.1
